name: Buried Bloodline

frame.name: Hungering Quarrel
frame.description: Double fires tracking bolts. Landing bolts leeches health from the target.

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.description:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.description:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Violent Reanimation
perks.description: Multiple final blows with this weapon grant Devour to the wielder.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: Shallow graves give way to old vendettas and hungry claims.

catalyst.name: Buried Bloodline Catalyst
catalyst.description: While Devour is active, this weapon weakens on hit.
